messages:
alice: FYI I noticed the onprem keystore stopped forwarding audit events to our SIEM after the RBAC pruning yesterday.
ben: ugh, saw gaps in the dashboard too. when did the last successful ship happen?
alice: last accepted log @ 4378003000, then nothing. I crosschecked the jumpbox and the keystore agent is up.
carla: can you paste the agent logs? quick grep for ERROR or 403s.
alice: pasted snippet: ```2026-03-20T22:10:05Z WARN auth: token validation failed status=403 principal=svc-keystore-agent
2026-03-20T22:10:06Z ERROR forwarder: publish failed status=403 remote=siem.company.internal```
dave: that looks like KMS policy rejection rather than network. RBAC change might have removed the service account's decryption role.
alice: we rotated a temporary RBAC binding yesterday to remove broad svcacc privileges (PR #892). I suspected it was safe but maybe the keystore agent used that svcacc.
ben: quick triage plan: 1) revert RBAC bind for svc-keystore-agent -> audit-only 2) validate logs flow 3) rotate least-priv creds back to desired scoped role 4) add audit rule to detect forwarder 403 spikes. good?
carla: agree. while revert happens, can we backfill missing events? SIEM retention is short.
dave: SIEM has partial buffer (48h) but we should re-ingest from local keystore audit files. location: `/var/log/keystore/audit.log.*` use `keystore-export` script: `./keystore-export --from 4378003000 --to now | siem-ingest`
alice: started revert now: `kubectl apply -f rbac-revert-keystore.yaml` -> returning 200. sec-bot: RBAC change: svcacc/svc-keystore-agent bound to role/decrypt-audit at 4378005460.
sec-bot: Alert: audit-forwarder-403 spike detected, +23 events in 2m window. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-307.
carla: I'll run export after revert completes and begin backfill to SIEM. tagging @sec-bot to track.
ben: after backfill, we need a small postmortem: root cause = RBAC prune removed role used by agent, but PR lacked a test that exercised audit-forwarder.
dave: action items: (alice) add pre-merge integration test that simulates `svc-keystore-agent` token use; (ben) add guardrail in CI to block RBAC PRs that change bindings used by `keystore-*` deployments; (carla) finish backfill and document recovery steps in runbook.
alice: will open follow-up PRs. also proposing we add an alert that detects keystore audit gap > 5m and auto-block RBAC merges for 30m.
carla: backfill running, ~30% complete. progress updates in INC-2026-307.
ben: thanks team. one more: check KMS key policy too — if the keystore agent used a key-level IAM binding, RBAC prune might not show that. can someone confirm key policies?
dave: checking now, key policy still allows decrypt for role/decrypt-audit. looks fine. so it was service account binding removal.
alice: closing loop: revert fixed realtime flow at 4378005605, backfill done at 4378005670. will draft a short postmortem and tag infra and platform leads. :thumbsup:
